name: CALCIUM LACTATE GLUCONATE / CALCIUM CARBONATE2.94/.3 GR 12 EFFERVESCENT TABLETS
description: The medication you’re looking for is a combination of calcium lactate gluconate and calcium carbonate in effervescent tablet form, providing 500 mg of ionizable calcium per tablet. It is used as a calcium supplement to treat or prevent calcium deficiencies. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
